caption:
Toddler always on the left hip, bag always on the right shoulder?

One-sided carrying is normal and not harmful, but hours of it every day can leave one side tired and achy. Swap sides on purpose, like at every doorway. Use both backpack straps, split shopping into two even bags, and hold kids close rather than perched out on a hip.

Carrying is lifting, so train for it: suitcase carries, squats and rows twice a week. Pain spreading with numbness or weakness, or waking you at night, is worth getting checked.

Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio pair hands-on care with simple exercises. Book online via the link in bio.
